firms.russiaStatusNote: Russia is not on the footer list, but the Terms (General Terms of Service, 'Effective Date: 16 October 2025', rechecked 2026-10-26, text unchanged since 2026-10-21) exclude sanctioned countries without naming them: 2.2 'Citizens, residents, or persons located in restricted or sanctioned countries are not eligible.' and 9.4 'Services are unavailable to residents of restricted/sanctioned regions; Persons on EU, UN, UK, or OFAC sanctions lists'. Governing law is Czech (11.3) and payments run through a Prague s.r.o. and a Hong Kong company. No primary source says Russia is accepted or excluded, so 'unclear', not 'available'. 2.2 tests citizenship, residence and location; 9.6 requires KYC and trading from IT infrastructure 'consistent with their actual geolocation' (VPN/VPS only if approved).
